item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal bon gshed dmar spyi 'dul rgyud las mngon rtogs gsal byed
item.coloph: de ltar khro bo gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi ting 'dzin gtor ma'i mngon rtogs gsal byed pa/ rgyud gzhung la 'byung ba bzhin gsal mod kyang / phyi rabs gang zag rjes 'breng rmongs bsal cing / bsnyen sgrub lag len man ngag ldan pa'i phyir/ khro bo rgyud gsum 'dus pa gtsor bzhag cing*/ mang la 'brel pa nyung la 'dus pa ru/ go don gsal byed cung tsam dbye ba 'di/ dad ldan slob ma rnams kyis bskul nas su/ dkar chag yi ge ris su btab pa di/ bka' skyong srungs ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ 'di la dag pa'i bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs/ bka' rgyud dri med nam mkha'i nyi shar bzhin/ sgrub rgyud bstan pa rab tu bskyed pa 'di/ dus mthar thug pa byin rlabs 'bar bar shog u ya/ shin tu zab bo/ gsang la spyod nas don dam myur/ dam med dag la bka' rgya btab/ (a+tha)sprul sku blo ldan snying pos sbyar ba'o//
